note: Customer repair tickets (Spec 3.2, 14.5a; Boss, 30 Oct 2026: the one job board, at Phoenix MX in every area). A ticket is a customer's part to put right, played at the board's stations like a shift (strip, fix, refit, test), never a single click. It pays base plus perGrade for each grade above 1 (£10 to £25 in Area 1, Spec 14.1), gives xpPerStation in the part's Mechanical Engineer skill at every station, and needs the tool set for its slot (data/tools.json) up to its grade. offers tickets are up at a time, fixed until one is finished; one open ticket per board, resumable (core/jobs.ts).
